blocks.text: Humans have long benefited from natural resources for their daily needs. The most ancient materials are wood, metals and those obtained from animals, such as clothes. With an enormous increase in the human population and limited natural resources, new materials and machines were needed. This led to the invention of a large number of materials, from metal alloys to nanomaterials, and from large electric cells to very efficient miniature batteries. Machines such as computers, mobile phones, construction machinery and aircraft all involve a combination of modern materials and energy devices.

blocks.title: Inside a mobile phone (Figure 31.1)
blocks.text: The book's Figure 31.1 is a photograph of a mobile phone. A phone contains a variety of metals, plastics and their composites, together with a small but efficient energy device: a lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery.

This chapter introduces the role of chemistry in modern materials and energy sources. It covers the preparation, properties and uses of metals, alloys, polymers and ceramics, and an analytical technique used to study them, X-ray crystallography. It then looks at energy density and specific energy, at fossil fuel, nuclear and solar energy, at the environmental effects of energy use, and at sustainable energy sources.

blocks.prompt: Name the kinds of material in a mobile phone and its energy device.
blocks.explanation: Metals, plastics and composites; the energy device is a lithium-ion battery.

items: New materials and energy devices were needed for a growing population.
A phone combines metals, plastics, composites and a Li-ion battery.
